precedence: Previously established hours, recurring programs, and circulation restrictions take precedence over Pass 4C suggested defaults. This file describes a fictional classroom institution, not verified facts about a real library.

hours.exceptions: Holiday exceptions and exceptional closures are not established; confirm with library staff.

membership.known: Library cards are free to local residents.
membership.unknown: Specific identification, residency-verification documents, nonresident eligibility, and application procedures are not established. Ask library staff; the demonstration does not issue cards or request real credentials.

circulation.fines: No overdue fines are charged. Replacement charges may apply for lost or damaged materials; real amounts and assessment procedures are not established. Separately, the fictional classroom service can show seeded charges and preview a courtesy credit or simulated settlement. It never collects real money or establishes real SPL charges.
circulation.renewalRule: Renew from the later of today or the current due date, for one format-specific loan period. Overdue loans may be renewed. Another patron's active work-level hold or two prior renewals blocks renewal.
circulation.holdRule: One active hold per work per account; at most five active holds. No holds on a work already checked out to this account. Child account C may hold Children or All Ages works only. Holds are simulated requests, not reservations of real stock.

rights: Equitable access to library resources and services
Intellectual freedom and freedom of inquiry
Confidentiality of library records and reasonable privacy protections
Information about applicable policies and procedures
responsibilities: Treat staff and other patrons respectfully
Handle library materials and equipment responsibly
Respect shared spaces and other patrons' access
Accept responsibility for lost or damaged materials under established policies
privacy: The library is committed to confidentiality of library records, freedom of inquiry, and equitable information access. This is a commitment, not a promise of absolute confidentiality or a legal guarantee. Record retention and disclosure procedures are not established. The classroom accounts are fictional and shared; their demonstration histories are visible to anyone selecting the same patron. Do not enter real credentials or private borrowing information in chat.
accessibility: Patrons are entitled to reasonable accommodations for accessibility. Specific equipment, accommodations, and request procedures are not established; ask library staff about the accommodation needed.
services: Catalog searching, holds, and circulation assistance
technology: Public computers, internet access, and Wi-Fi are offered. Computer time limits, reservations, specific equipment, and current availability are not established; ask staff for those details.
rooms: Meeting-room availability, booking procedures, and rules are not established; ask library staff. Pericles cannot reserve a room.

contact.unknown: Official street address, telephone number, email, and service-desk locations are not established for this fictional library. Ask library staff for confirmation.

challenges: The library supports intellectual freedom and equitable access to lawful information. Specific challenge or reconsideration procedures are not established; ask library staff for the applicable policy.
